author: Andrea DiP
title: Governadora de Pernambuco sugere laqueadura forçada: por que certas mulheres não importam?
content:
Raquel Lyra, governadora de Pernambuco e candidata à reeleição pelo PSD, aparece em um vídeo divulgado pelo portal Metrópoles no último domingo (20), sugerindo que uma mulher seja esterilizada sem seu conhecimento.

 O episódio aconteceu em 2025, quando Lyra visitava o Hospital Regional Dom Moura, em Garanhuns.

No vídeo

, uma mulher, provavelmente funcionária do hospital, gesticula com as mãos ao falar sobre a barriga de uma paciente que não aparece nas imagens. “Chega assim, ó, gestante, desse tamanho, com sete ‘menino’ na barriga”. Ao que a governadora responde: “Aí tem que fazer laqueadura, visse? A gente bota na fila da laqueadura”. Alguém diz algo ininteligível e ela acrescenta: “Mas faz sem ela saber”.


O vídeo viralizou, e a governadora assumiu a fala, pediu desculpas,

 mas em nota ao Metrópoles, terminou dizendo que a “eleição deve ser decidida na apresentação de propostas, não na fabricação de ataques”

e que


a divulgação do vídeo “trata-se de mais uma tentativa de desviar o foco do que realmente importa, que é Pernambuco”. 


Esse “o que realmente importa”, pra mim, aponta o cerne da questão: a de que

algumas mulheres não importam, ou umas importam mais do que outras. E alguns úteros podem ser mais tutelados – pelo Estado, pela religião, pela medicina, pela política

, dentro de uma visão eugenista, racista e misógina. O Brasil tem uma longa história com isso.


A laqueadura é um procedimento cirúrgico de esterilização que tem como objetivo impedir a gravidez. Faz-se um corte na ligação entre os ovários e o útero, que é feita por meio das trompas.

E fazer uma laqueadura sem informar ou ter o consentimento da mulher é crime no Brasil, com pena de até oito anos de prisão e multa.


Em 2018,

a

Agência Pública

 contou a história de Janaína

, uma mulher de 35 anos do interior de São Paulo que, em situação de vulnerabilidade, teve uma laqueadura determinada pela Justiça. A reportagem conta que o Ministério Público determinou um prazo para que a prefeitura esterilizasse Janaina, sob a alegação de que ela era “pessoa hipossuficiente, apresenta grave quadro de dependência química, sendo usuária contumaz de substâncias entorpecentes, além de ser mãe de cinco filhos” e de que “não tem condições financeiras de arcar com os correspondentes custos”. Pouco antes de a decisão ser emitida, foi anexada ao processo uma certidão firmada em cartório, em que Janaina concordava com a realização da laqueadura. Mas em entrevista à

Pública

, ela disse não saber ler ou escrever e afirmou ter assinado o documento sem saber do que se tratava.


Janaína foi esterilizada à força, e apenas anos depois recebeu uma compensação do Estado por essa violência. 


Mas dá pra ir além.

Nos anos 1990, uma CPMI da laqueadura involuntária foi instaurada, presidida pela deputada Benedita da Silva, para investigar a incidência de esterilização em massa de mulheres no Brasil. Números do IBGE apontavam que 45% das mulheres em idade fértil estavam esterilizadas na época, índices muito superiores aos de outros países.

 E o

relatório final

 da CPMI dizia: “É sintomático constatar que o maior percentual de esterilizadas encontra-se exatamente nos Estados e regiões que concentram os maiores índices de miséria e pobreza do nosso país e onde a composição populacional aponta para uma maioria negra, como por exemplo o Nordeste e o Centro-Oeste. Por outro lado, em Estados de maioria branca, como por exemplo o Rio Grande do Sul, o índice de mulheres esterilizadas fica abaixo da média nacional”.

A CPMI concluiu que as mulheres passavam pelos procedimentos sem o devido conhecimento necessário, imediatamente após cesarianas, que laqueaduras eram oferecidas como escambo eleitoral ou como único método contraceptivo disponível. Apontava ainda que “havia um claro interesse internacional no controle demográfico no Brasil”.


Uma

reportagem

 do Intercept, também de 2018, lembrou o que foi esse interesse estrangeiro: “Esses programas eram capitaneados por entidades que, segundo diversos depoimentos, seguiam orientações que constam no chamado Relatório Kissinger, documento norte-americano classificado como sigiloso (…). O Relatório Kissinger foi adotado como política oficial pelo presidente Gerald Ford em 1975 e defendia que o crescimento populacional dos países menos desenvolvidos era uma ameaça para a segurança nacional americana, pois geraria riscos de distúrbios civis e instabilidade política. Para conter o avanço demográfico, o relatório defendia a …

author: Daron Letts
title: Iqaluit council rejects renaming sewage lagoon ‘Trump Lake’
content:
A call to rename Iqaluit’s sewage lagoon Trump Lake died without a vote after no one seconded deputy Mayor Kim Smith’s motion during Tuesday night’s council meeting.


“I figure if (U.S. President Donald Trump) can rename landmarks, then so can we — and we can share a very polite Canadian giggle while we do,” Smith said as she presented her motion, adding no sign would be erected nor any public funds used if the lagoon were to be “symbolically renamed.”


Trump has signed executive orders to rename two bodies of water — the Gulf of Mexico in February 2025 and Lake Ontario in August. The new names, Gulf of America and Lake America respectively, are officially changed in the U.S. government’s Geographic Names Information System, and all federal departments and agencies must follow suit.

But the change does not apply outside the United States.


In her roughly three-minute pitch, Smith expressed her opposition to several of Trump’s actions, including his threats to take over Greenland, the Iran war, and the ongoing trade war with Canada.


The U.S. president has repeatedly mused, joked and threatened to make Canada the “51st state,” and his aggressive use of tariffs has caused economic uncertainty across the nation.


Coun. Kyle Sheppard was the only other councillor to speak to the motion.


He said that while he shares Smith’s “disdain for the current U.S. administration,” he embraced a sentiment expressed in a 2016 campaign speech by former First Lady Michelle Obama: “When they go low, we go high.”


Smith told Nunatsiaq News after the meeting she regarded her act “a success” despite the result.


“My goal at the end of the day was to let residents know that I am all too aware that they are feeling the squeeze, and to give them something to laugh at when they drive down the causeway,” she said.

author: Emma Honeybun
title: National poll shows high support of Indigenous-led wildfire approach
content:
Results from a new poll show that 83 per cent of Canadians want to see more Indigenous fire stewardship to allow for increased wildfire prevention and response.


The poll,

Canadian’s Thoughts on Prevention and Response

, was organized by the Indigenous Leadership Initiative (ILI) and used data from approximately 2,250 adults living in Canada over 10 days from Aug. 21 to 31.


The ILI is a national organization

 that supports Indigenous communities in conservation and development efforts through money, research and consultation.


The survey asked participants if they had been impacted by wildfires in recent years; if they had heard of Indigenous fire stewardship; and about how they’d like federal dollars to be spent when it comes to wildfire response, among other questions.


Findings showed that while 49 per cent of participants did not know what Indigenous fire stewardship was prior to taking part, 84 per cent were in support once it was explained to them, and 83 per cent wanted to see more of it.


Indigenous fire stewardship (IFS) is a “strengths-based, rights-based and complementary pathway that recognizes Indigenous self-determination and leadership in the use of fire on the land,” ILI stated in a report published alongside poll results. “It is a vision of what healthy landscapes should look like and how processes like fire would operate within that landscape.”


IFS includes cultural burning and the intentional use of fire to monitor “the frequency, seasonality, intensity and scale of fires to promote landscape health,” according to the report.


It also supports Indigenous leadership in wildfire response and using Indigenous knowledge to “help landscapes and communities recover post-fire.”


Valérie Courtois, ILI’s executive director and a registered forester, said she wasn’t surprised that almost half of the participants weren’t aware of Indigenous fire stewardship beforehand.


“We [Indigenous Guardians] are a small part of the population, and the reality in this country is that the majority of the population lives within 100 miles of the American border and don’t necessarily interact with Guardians, or the work of Indigenous Nations on a daily basis. And so it’s not surprising to me that Canadians are unaware of that,” she said. “It’s also not surprising to me that when they hear about the amazing work that Guardians are doing, that they become a fan of it, because I’m a fan of that work.”


IFS is generally taken care of by fire guardians, one of many forms of Indigenous Guardians, which, according to the federal government, are considered the “eyes and ears on-the-ground, monitoring ecological health, maintaining cultural sites, and protecting sensitive areas and species.”


Read more:


Fighting fires with good fire: How Indigenous land guardians are protecting the boreal forest


Ottawa has been funding

Indigenous Guardian initiatives

 since 2017. Grants are awarded to initiatives that focus on “protecting and conserving ecosystems, developing and maintaining sustainable economies, and continuing the profound connections between natural landscapes and Indigenous cultures,” according to its website.


When asked how to spend a “$250 million federal wildfire investment,” according to poll results, 52 per cent of participants chose the addition of 750 Indigenous Fire Guardians, who work to prevent wildfires through the use of cultural burning and knowledge of the land on a year-round basis.


According to the poll, Canadians would prefer further investment in fire guardians over leasing more water bombers “almost two to one,” and 82 per cent of them pushed for increased federal funding for fire stewardship in general.


Courtois said that while the Guardians are able to help their own Nations and communities, the work is important for Canadians as a whole.


“Canada is a very big country and it’s a difficult place to keep an eye on,” Courtois said, adding that government branches don’t always have the resources to fulfill land management in that regard.

There are also moments when land or fire management must be localized, she said, and that “all of the factors that play into how you make decisions have to be understood at that level, and cannot just be generalized.

author: Corey Larocque
title: NTI president extols the power of an ‘informed Inuk’ at Kivalliq Trade Show
content:
The world is changing fast, as are interests in the North. There’s pressure to mine Nunavut’s natural resources and to develop infrastructure projects that support Arctic security and sovereignty.


That’s why Inuit need to listen to each other, to their communities and to their youth, says Nunavut Tunngavik Inc. president Gloria Uluqsi.


Big decisions lie ahead about the impacts of future economic activity.


“An informed Inuk is much harder to leave out of a decision that affects them,” Uluqsi said Tuesday in a speech to the Kivalliq Trade Show in Rankin Inlet this week.


She didn’t mention any projects by name. But there has been talk at the trade show about Agnico Eagle Mines’ gold mining and exploration, as well as the four nation-building projects going through the federal government’s Major Projects Office.


Those projects are the Kivalliq Hydro-Fibre Project, the Grays Bay Road and Port Project, a hydroelectricity generator near Iqaluit, and a deepsea port in Qikiqtarjuaq.


Uluqsi leaned into the trade show’s theme — Naalagit, or “Listen” in English. She spoke about what it means to listen and what it means to be heard.


As projects move forward, Inuit need to be heard by government and developers, she said. It has to be a true consultation.


“We need to be involved early enough to really help define the problem, identify the opportunities, consider the risk, and shape the options,” said Uluqsi, a former Government of Nunavut public servant who won the NTI presidency in a May byelection.


“Being asked what we think after the decisions have been made is not meaningful participation.”


NTI advocates for the rights Nunavut Inuit are entitled to under the Nunavut Agreement, and Uluqsi said her organization has a responsibility to ensure Inuit beneficiaries understand those rights.


She also talked about the importance of encouraging young people to have confidence in themselves and about inspiriting Nunavut’s Inuit.


Trade shows are traditionally where businesspeople come together with a goal of making deals with each other. But Uluqsi encouraged participants to do more than exchange business cards and contracts.


She called on participants to exchange knowledge and ideas.


Listening doesn’t always mean agreeing or being liked. But it leads to a better understanding.


“If I understand why you hold your position, and you understand why I hold mine, we have a much better place to begin. That is how relationships are built. That is how trust is built, and that is how better decisions are made.”


The Kivalliq Trade Show ends Wednesday.

author: David Swanson
title: Quiz: Are You a Foreign Policy and History Genius?
content:
By David Swanson, World BEYOND War, September 23, 2026


Grab paper and pencil. Write down the numbers 1 through 10 and get ready to mark down next to them either “True” or “False.” Think I can trick you? Ten items follow. Which are true and which false? See the answers at the end.


1.

 The grandfather of the current leader of North Korea, the guy who ruled over North Korea from 1945 to 1994, was more of a Presbyterian than a Communist. Kim Il Sung was raised in a Christian community created by U.S. missionaries, was a Sunday School teacher and church organist, and leader of a Christian youth group. Kim Il Sung did not turn against Christianity so much as choose to himself play the role of Jesus in the story. He changed his name to take the name of a mythical messiah figure (Kim Il Sung), beating out Sun Myung Moon who had the same idea. Kim Il Sung encouraged beliefs in his supernatural powers. He was said to have performed miracles, to have known more as a child than the scholars, to heal with the touch of his hands, and to be especially fond of fishermen. He set aside a Sabbath-like day for worshipping him and learning his words as gospel. One could not take his name in vain or mistreat any image of him. Christian-like hymns praised his glory. Instead of 10 commandments, there were now 10 principles which included effectively that one would have no other gods besides Kim Il Sung. His mother became a Marylike figure. And, like at least one Trump staffer, some of Kim Il Sung’s family was said to have the power to teleport.


2.

 The nation far and away most often referred to as the richest country in the world, the United States, is not, and for a very long time has not been, and for the foreseeable future will not be the richest country in the world.


3.

 It was March 23, 1775, and a wealthy, white man who owned many people as slaves was giving a speech in a church in Richmond, Virginia. What he said was not recorded, but we know that he spoke critically of rule by England. An account just the next week by a man who had attended the speech tells us that the speaker called King George III, “a Tyrant, a fool, a puppet, and a tool.” This orator may have merely hinted at revolution, as on other occasions, or he may have openly advocated it. He also probably spoke on this day, as he did on others before and after, of the need to militarily suppress slave revolts and to resist any British efforts to free people from slavery, as well as of the need to attack Native Americans to the west, where this man was making a fortune on land speculation. Forty-two years later, a supposed text of the speech was published, having been concocted from decades-old memories solicited second-hand and probably some sheer invention. The original speaker had long since died. But now we learned that he had spoken against a metaphorical enslavement to England, and possibly even acted out liberating himself from invisible bondage. Words put into his mouth included these: “I know not what course others may take; but as for me, give me liberty, or give me death.” He, Patrick Henry, may or may not have actually said that, but there is no record of Patrick Henry subsequently risking death; he saw no combat action. He did, however, campaign against ratification of the U.S. Constitution. His rallying cry popularizing a war theretofore desired mostly by elites, is sufficient, however, to rank him as a heroic Founding Father of the United States of America. It is reported that in 1800 an enslaved man in Virginia named Gabriel, leading Gabriel’s Rebellion, at least planned to create a banner reading “death or liberty.” This is widely described as a reference to Patrick Henry’s speech even though it reverses the phrase, happened long before the speech was published, and involved someone actually in need of liberty and actually risking death. Gabriel has not been made into a founding father, but was hung by the neck.


4.

 Weeks before the first nuclear bomb was dropped on Japan, on July 13, 1945, Japan had sent a telegram to the Soviet Union expressing its desire to surrender and end the war. The United States had broken Japan’s codes and read the telegram. President Truman referred in his diary to “the telegram from Jap Emperor asking for peace.” Truman had already been informed through Swiss and Portuguese channels of Japanese peace overtures as early as three months before Hiroshima. Japan objected only to surrendering unconditionally and giving …

author: Unknown
title: Kurdish writer Suzan Samancı detained upon entering Turkey, placed under a travel ban
content:
Kurdish writer Suzan Samancı was detained on Tuesday at Istanbul Airport while entering Turkey. The author, who has been living in Switzerland for 18 years, is under investigation on allegations of “propaganda for a terrorist organization.” Following her statement, she was released under judicial supervision and placed under a travel ban.


Her detention was made public by lawyer and human rights activist Eren Keskin. “Kurdish writer Suzan Samancı, who has been living in Switzerland for 18 years, returned to Turkey today. She was detained at Istanbul Airport on allegations of ‘propaganda for an organization,’” Keskin stated.


After her questioning was completed, Samancı was first referred to the prosecutor’s office and then brought before a judge. Via videoconference, the 64-year-old writer was connected to the competent court in Amed (Diyarbakır). The court imposed a travel ban as a judicial control measure and ordered Samancı’s release.


From Turkish-language literature to writing in Kurdish


Suzan Samancı is from Amed and has been part of the Kurdish literary scene for decades. She began her literary career with poetry before turning primarily to short stories and novels. She also wrote for newspapers including Demokrasi, Gündem, and Özgür Politika. She is a member of the writers’ association PEN.


Her well-known works include the short story collections

Eriyip Gidiyor Gece, Reçine Kokuyordu Helin, Kıraç Dağlar Kar Tuttu,

 and

Suskunun Gölgesinde

. In 1997, she received second prize in the Orhan Kemal Short Story Competition for

Kıraç Dağlar Kar Tuttu

. Her works have been translated into several languages.


After initially writing in Turkish, Samancı published

Ew Jin û Mêrê Bi Maske

 in 2015, her first short story collection written in her native Kurdish. In 2019, she published

Mirzayê Reben

, her first Kurdish-language novel. Most recently, in 2024, she published

Payiz an jî Ziyab

, another novel written in Kurdish.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: "New Low in U.N. History": Trita Parsi on Trump's Threat to Annihilate Iran at General Assembly
content: The annual meeting of the United Nations General Assembly opened this week in New York City. On its opening day, President Trump in his address to all 193 U.N. member states threatened to annihilate Iran. “This is probably a new low in U.N. history,” says Trita Parsi of the Quincy Institute for Responsible Statecraft, joining us in our New York City studio ahead of the second day of the General Assembly. As Trump pushes for even more sanctions on Iran, “what you’re most likely to see in that scenario is that the Iranians will counter-escalate” in what threatens to become an “endless war.” Parsi also comments on the U.S. military’s growing reliance on artificial intelligence for strategic and targeting decisions, Trump’s upcoming meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and the Trump administration’s flouting of international law.

title: Mansur Yavaş’ın ardından CHP’de iki istifa daha: Beypazarı ve Kalecik belediye başkanları partiden ayrıldı
content:
Beypazarı Belediye Başkanı Özer Kasap | Kalecik Belediye Başkanı Satılmış Karakoç

Ankara Büyükşehir Belediye (ABB) Başkanı Mansur Yavaş’ın CHP üyeliğinden istifa ederek siyasi yoluna bağımsız olarak devam edeceğini açıklamasının ardından iki ilçe belediye başkanı daha CHP’den ayrıldı.

Beypazarı Belediye Başkanı Özer Kasap ve Kalecik Belediye Başkanı Satılmış Karakoç, sosyal medya hesaplarından yaptıkları açıklamalarla CHP üyeliğinden istifa ettiklerini ve belediye başkanlığı görevlerini bağımsız olarak sürdüreceklerini bildirdi.

Kalecik Belediye Başkanı Satılmış Karakoç, CHP üyeliğinden ayrılarak görevini bağımsız sürdüreceğini açıkladı.

Karakoç, “İçinden geçtiğimiz süreç ve yaşanan gelişmeler doğrultusunda, Cumhuriyet Halk Partisi üyeliğimden ayrılarak Belediye Başkanlığı görevime bağımsız olarak devam etme kararı aldım” dedi.

Mansur Yavaş’la birlikte hareket etmeyi sürdüreceğini belirten Karakoç, “Mansur Yavaş Başkanımızla çıktığımız yolun temelinde de aynı anlayış vardı: İnsanları siyasi kimlikleriyle değil, insan oldukları için kucaklamak; ayrıştırmadan, adaletle ve halkın emanetine sahip çıkarak hizmet etmek. Bugün de kendisiyle çıktığımız bu yolda, Mansur Başkanımızın yanında yürümeye devam edeceğim” ifadelerini kullandı.

Beypazarı Belediye Başkanı Özer Kasap da sosyal medya hesabından yaptığı açıklamayla CHP’den ayrıldığını bildirdi.

Kasap, “Bugün geldiğimiz noktada, Cumhuriyet Halk Partisi üyeliğimden ayrılıyor, siyasi yoluma bağımsız olarak devam etme kararı aldığımı kamuoyunun takdirine sunuyorum” dedi.

Mansur Yavaş’la birlikte çıktıkları yola vurgu yapan Kasap, “Mansur Yavaş Başkanımızla çıktığımız bu yolda, bana güvenen ve destek veren hemşehrilerime verdiğim sözlerin arkasındayım” ifadelerini kullandı.

title: Öztürk: Commission should not limit Öcalan’s role
content:
The Monitoring and Evaluation Board, established in line with the framework law adopted by Parliament as part of the Peace and Democratic Society Process, formed four subcommissions following its first meeting on 24 August. The inclusion of Abdullah Öcalan in one of these bodies, the “Disarmament and Strategic Coordination Subcommission,” has brought his role in advancing the process to the fore.


Öcalan’s involvement in the commission’s work is regarded as a critical step towards a democratic solution to the Kurdish question and the establishment of lasting peace.


Raziye Öztürk, a lawyer from the Asrın Law Office, spoke to ANF about the current stage of the process and Öcalan’s status.


Mr. Öcalan’s direct participation is valuable


Raziye Öztürk described the establishment of commissions within Parliament as an important threshold at the current stage and said the way should be opened for Mr. Öcalan to participate in the process directly and officially.


Öztürk said: “Undoubtedly, the establishment of commissions within Parliament and the institutional character this gives to the process can be regarded as an important threshold at the stage we have reached. At the same time, we consider every step that enables Mr. Öcalan to participate in the process directly and officially and to effectively fulfil his role to be valuable for advancing the process.


Unfortunately, however, the very name ‘Disarmament and Strategic Coordination Subcommission’ draws a framework that restricts both the commission’s scope of work and Mr. Öcalan’s role. Unfortunately, developments to date have also confirmed this assessment.


The process began with statements and assessments drawing attention to the historical nature of Kurdish-Turkish relations, the partnership in the founding of the Republic and the damage caused to society by many years of conflict. From the outset, there was, of course, an approach that reduced the Kurdish question solely to disarmament and insisted on this. Nevertheless, it could be said that a broader perspective addressing the issue in its historical, political and social dimensions prevailed in the process.”


Security-centred approach has not produced a solution


Raziye Öztürk said the Kurdish question has repeatedly been addressed through security-centred policies in the past and that this approach has failed to produce a lasting solution.


Öztürk also said: “This is precisely why we believe there should be no return to the security-centred approach that has been tried repeatedly in the past. As we have seen with the approach that defines the Kurdish question solely under the heading of ‘terrorism’ and seeks to resolve it through unilateral security policies, this understanding has not produced a solution to date. It is clear that an approach focused solely on ‘disarmament’ will lead to the same outcome.


The mechanisms established today must therefore avoid reproducing the same approach and instead make it possible to address the issue in all its dimensions and develop solutions on the basis of democratic politics. What is decisive here is the approach with which the commission will work and the task it sets itself.”


Disarmament is not the process itself


Öztürk said disarmament is one of the important stages of the process but should not be seen as the process in its entirety, adding that the transition from armed conflict to democratic politics also involves political, social and legal transformations.


Öztürk continued: “We do not disregard the fact that disarmament is one of the important stages of this process. But disarmament is not the process itself; it is one stage in the transition from armed conflict to democratic politics and a lasting solution. What is at stake, therefore, is not merely coordinating the removal of weapons from the equation, but how to achieve the political, social and legal transformation this requires. Mr. Öcalan is the key actor who has defined the strategy and method for precisely this transformation.


The perspective he has put forward has a broader framework that is based not only on ending armed conflict, but also on strengthening democratic politics, resolving the issue on political and legal grounds, and building social peace.


Mr. Öcalan’s direct participation in the process will therefore ensure that this perspective is also reflected in the negotiations and the mechanisms that have been established. There is no doubt that such participation would …

title: Alparslan: Ministry’s decision to separate Zazaki from Kurdish aims to create division
content:
The 2026–2027 academic year began on 14 September. One week before the start of the new school year, the Ministry of National Education (MEB) introduced a separate curriculum for Zazaki (Kirmanckî), which it had previously treated alongside Kurmancî as a dialect of Kurdish.


The new programme, prepared under the “Century of Turkey Education Model”, places Zazaki within the education system as a separate curriculum. It was also decided that Zazaki textbooks would be revised and that the field would be designated as a separate branch for teacher appointments.


As the first week of the new academic year came to an end, Istanbul Kurdish Institute Co-Chair Remziye Alparslan spoke to ANF about the impact of mother-tongue education on children’s development and the Ministry’s decision to treat Zazaki as a subject separate from Kurdish.


Alparslan said mother-tongue education is important not only for the individual development of children beginning their education, but also for preserving cultural identity. 


Alparslan said: “Education in the mother tongue is extremely important for children to begin school in the language that shapes their identity, culture and roots, without becoming alienated from themselves or disconnected from their families and roots, and with a sense of self-confidence. It is equally vital for the transmission, preservation and development of the mother tongue and, consequently of Kurdish culture and identity. Educational scientists and pedagogues are better placed to assess its impact on children’s education. However, education in the mother tongue is crucial so that children raised in their mother tongue do not suddenly find themselves in an unfamiliar environment, can acquire other languages with greater ease, feel that they are a natural part of the society around them, and grow into confident, multilingual and multicultural individuals without being subjected to discrimination or exclusion.”


Mother-tongue education is a democratic demand of all peoples


Remziye Alparslan said the right to education in the mother tongue is a democratic demand shared by all peoples who form part of society and drew attention to the history of the struggle. 


Alparslan also said: “The demand for mother-tongue education, which has come to the fore through the struggle of the Kurdish people, is fundamentally a longstanding democratic demand that seeks to include all peoples and cultures rather than exclude them on the basis of belonging, identity or difference. This struggle has been waged in many different ways over the years, through petitions, boycotts, marches and press statements. For years, there have been demands to remove the barriers to mother-tongue education and, in the case of Kurds, to education in Kurdish, and for Kurdish to be used at every level of education, from preschool to university.”


Policies based on denial must be abandoned


Alparslan said policies based on the denial of mother tongues are not sustainable if societies are to live together freely, voluntarily and in peace.


Alparslan contunied: “Kurds have rights arising from their existence as a people. Regardless of the official language of the country in which they live, they have the right to preserve and develop their own culture, language and existence as a people. As in other contemporary countries, there is no reason for this to be obstructed. There are dozens of examples around the world and in Europe. Turkey must therefore find the courage to break free from this cycle of suppression, denial and disregard, and recognise that doing so is a prerequisite for all communities to live together freely, voluntarily and in peace. The current situation is no longer sustainable and will inevitably encounter the same familiar problems again. As long as the Kurdish people exist, they will continue their struggle for their mother tongue, culture and rights, and sooner or later they will achieve them.”


Criticism of Ministry’s Zazaki decision: ‘The timing is no coincidence’


Alparslan said the timing of the Ministry of National Education’s decision in the first week of September to separate Zazaki from Kurdish and introduce a separate curriculum appeared to have been deliberately chosen to provoke controversy. She stated that Kurdish was being deliberately reduced to one of its varieties, Kurmancî.


Alparslan said: “I believe that the attempt to create a dichotomy between Kurdish and Zazaki, to equate Kurmancî with Kurdish and then …

title: The red star of Istanbul: Egîd Tolhildan
content:
Throughout history, some cities have been remembered not only as geographical centres but also as symbolic places of resistance and social struggle. Stretching from Havana and Stalingrad to Chiapas and Kobanê, these cities have carved out a distinctive place in the history of peoples’ struggles.


Cities also hold a special place in the history of the Kurdish Freedom Movement in terms of resistance. Some have stood out for mass serhildans, or uprisings, while others have become known for the revolutionaries they nurtured and who took part in the struggle. Istanbul is one of the cities that embodies both.


 


Istanbul has witnessed decades of mass demonstrations and resistance throughout the history of the Kurdish Freedom Movement. Newroz uprisings, university protests, demonstrations against the international conspiracy, resistance in solidarity with Kobanê and Rojava, and actions carried out by the Patriotic Revolutionary Youth Movement (YDG-H), which was active between 2013 and 2016, marked important moments in this history.


Istanbul’s significance for the Kurdish Freedom Movement has not been limited to mass mobilisation. The city has also become associated with the many revolutionaries who joined the ranks of the movement. Around 120 of those included in a list of martyrs recently announced by the People’s Defence Forces (HPG) were revolutionaries who had joined the struggle from Istanbul.


One of them was Egîd Tolhildan (Yoldaş Anık).


A child who grew up amid resistance


Egîd turned towards resistance from an early age. Born into a poor family, he grew up against the backdrop of the 1990s, a period remembered in Kurdish history for major resistance and massacres. His family moved to Istanbul at a time when villages were being burned and forced displacement was intensifying across Kurdistan. Egîd grew up in a poor neighbourhood of Istanbul, where he developed a strong sense of Kurdish patriotism.


Egîd worked to help support his family while also fulfilling what he saw as his patriotic responsibilities, taking part in resistance against the repression and massacres faced by his people. He neither abandoned his family nor stayed away from the resistance.


Egîd became involved in youth organising in Istanbul at a time when attacks described by the Kurdish movement as genocidal were intensifying in Kurdistan and attacks on Rojava were escalating. He took part in resistance against these attacks in both Rojava and Northern Kurdistan (Bakur). As the Self-Government Resistance unfolded and attacks involving massacres intensified in Rojava, Egîd turned towards the mountains.


Resistance was in his very nature


As we make our way to Egîd’s home, we enter the neighbourhood that took shape in the 1990s and still retains its Kurdish and patriotic identity. We soon realise how many people in the neighbourhood knew Egîd when we tell them we are looking for his home. Everyone we speak to says resistance was in his very nature.


H

e was detained, but once released, he would not stop


Egîd began struggling to make a living at a young age, but always placed the party and the guerrillas at the centre of his life. He worked for a time as a shoe shiner before finding a job in a textile workshop. His mother, Suphiye, recounts what followed: “From what I could see, he was not doing much at first. He was going to school. He used to feel embarrassed when I came to the school wearing my headscarf and would say, ‘Don’t come to me.’ We built houses for his cousins, and later we moved here. We built our own home in Karayolları. My children would go out to shine shoes and come back, and with what they earned we would make food for ourselves. Yoldaş loved the struggle; he was with the party. I would wake up in the evenings and see him sitting at the computer watching footage of the party. That was how he eventually joined the party.


He would go to demonstrations. The police raided our home every day. They would ask for Yoldaş; they wanted Yoldaş. I woke him up and told him, ‘My child, don’t be afraid. They will take your statement and release you, and you will come back home.’ Once he was released, his father brought him home. But he still would not stop; he kept going to demonstrations. I would tell him, ‘They will arrest you and they won’t let you go next time.’ He left after the Ankara massacre, and we never saw him again.”

title: Il tempo del riscatto
content:
da

Quarticciolo Ribelle


Con le nostre auto, ormai esenti da bollo, siamo obbligati a guardare un enorme schermo pubblicitario installato su viale Togliatti che mostra Meloni invitata al convegno di Gioventù Nazionale con lo slogan 

“

il 

𝘵𝘦𝘮𝘱𝘰 𝘥𝘦𝘭 𝘤𝘰𝘳𝘢𝘨𝘨𝘪𝘰

”.


Ci vuole molto coraggio, in effetti, a parlare alla Nazione raccontando di quanto è difficile fare il Presidente del Consiglio. Perché, dal canto nostro, ogni mattina cerchiamo il coraggio di abitare a Quarticciolo, a Rozzano, a Tor Sapienza e, come noi, in tutte quelle periferie del paese abbandonate da decenni.


Perché ci vuole coraggio a camminare per le strade avendo paura di essere aggrediti. Ci vuole coraggio a svegliarsi con le grida di chi è stato accoltellato o peggio gambizzato. Ci vuole coraggio ad andare a scuola tutte le mattine alla Verga o alla Pirotta. Ci vuole coraggio a vivere in case dove ti crolla il soffitto alla prima pioggia. Ci vuole coraggio a non abbandonarle e trasferirsi lontano. Ci vuole coraggio a decidere, nonostante tutto, di restare.


Ci vuole coraggio a crederci ogni giorno, che il cambiamento può avvenire. A non scoraggiarsi quando Del Mastro, un ministro della 𝘯𝘢𝘻𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘦, siede allo stesso tavolo con chi permette che i nostri quartieri siano il centro commerciale del disagio. Ci vuole coraggio a non credere che chiunque occupi le poltrone del Parlamento si dimentichi delle condizioni in cui siamo costretti a vivere.


Ci vuole coraggio a credere e ad affermare che in questo paese possa crescere 𝘶𝘯𝘢 𝘨𝘦𝘯𝘦𝘳𝘢𝘻𝘪𝘰𝘯𝘦 𝘤𝘩𝘦 𝘴𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘧𝘪𝘨𝘨𝘦 𝘭𝘢 𝘱𝘢𝘶𝘳𝘢 𝘥𝘦𝘭 𝘧𝘶𝘵𝘶𝘳𝘰. Il popolo, come ci chiama Meloni, non ha opportunità perché in questi luoghi non c’è niente se non quello che a fatica tentiamo di costruire.


Molti di questi quartieri sono stati commissariati dal dl Caivano bis e oggi, sono passati due interi anni, di quei 180 milioni di euro stanziati complessivamente in tutta Italia, non c’è niente di concreto.


Gli abitanti di Quarticciolo nel 2025 erano riusciti a fare approvare un piano periferie adatto ai bisogni di chi ci vive proprio perché siamo 𝘤𝘪𝘵𝘵𝘢𝘥𝘪𝘯𝘪 𝘭𝘪𝘣𝘦𝘳𝘪 𝘥𝘪 𝘱𝘳𝘦𝘵𝘦𝘯𝘥𝘦𝘳𝘦 𝘲𝘶𝘦𝘭𝘭𝘰 𝘤𝘩𝘦 è 𝘨𝘪𝘶𝘴𝘵𝘰

.


Le risorse stanziate serviranno, prima o poi, per rendere gli spazi abbandonati fruibili con servizi e attività economiche? Serviranno per rendere le nostre case più sicure? Serviranno per assegnare le centinaia di case vuote del nostro quartiere?


Ma mentre Meloni racconta del suo di coraggio, la sicurezza è un tema sempre più importante: aggressioni, rapine, pestaggi, incendi. Basta chiedere a chi abita a Rozzano se il DL emergenze ha migliorato la sicurezza.  Perché nessuno sta facendo niente con le risorse stanziate? E che nessuno dica che sono stati impediti interventi con la forza pubblica. Sono arrivati con i passamontagna, gli elicotteri, i blindati, hanno chiuso strade, perquisito scantinati, arrestato gente in mezzo alla strada. Nulla è cambiato.


Meloni, Presidente del Consiglio, è questo il coraggio di cui si sente orgogliosa?


Ci dispiace che ha bisogno di coraggio per fare il presidente, ma non è il nostro mestiere. Basterebbe dare seguito agli annunci che lei ha fatto, alle promesse della Regione Lazio, dell’Ater e del Comune di Roma.


Noi facciamo quello che possiamo ed è l’unica cosa che esiste: a 10 anni dall’occupazione della Palestra Popolare nasce un Campo da Calcio gestito dalla squadra popolare Borgata Gordiani. Tutto riqualificato con le risorse derivate dall’alleanza tra due quartieri.


Non è tanto, ma è un altro spazio di questo quartiere, tra Quarticciolo e Tor Sapienza, sottratto al degrado, presidiato da chi si allena, reso sicuro da chi lo attraversa.


Noi non abbiamo scelto di 𝘢𝘱𝘱𝘢𝘳𝘪𝘳𝘦 𝘮𝘢 𝘥𝘪 𝘢𝘱𝘱𝘢𝘳𝘵𝘦𝘯𝘦𝘳𝘦 ad un quartiere, di attraversare queste strade, di rischiare di sbagliare, di ricevere critiche e a volte sostegno. E questo richiede tanto coraggio. Il coraggio di tentare di sottrarre al tempo della politica il tempo del riscatto.

:

If you must use AGAB language to discuss perisex topics (gross), then at the very least please use it properly. It’s not “AMAB people” and “AFAB people”, or even worse, “AMABs” and “AFABs”

It’s an acronym, so expand on it, and see if you still make sense. “Assigned female at birth people” sounds dumb as hell, but “people who were assigned female at birth” sounds fine, so in acronym form it should be “people who were AMAB” and “people who were AFAB”

content:
Diffondiamo l’appello dei

Giovani Palestinesi d’Italia

 per una mobilitazione nazionale sui territori il 10 ottobre 2026.


Dopo tre anni di genocidio a Gaza, il popolo palestinese continua ad affrontare massacri, assedio, carestia e pulizia etnica, mentre in Cisgiordania si intensificano i raid militari e le violenze dei coloni.


Nonostante il calo dell’attenzione mediatica e le false pacificazioni, i crimini e l’oppressione non si sono fermati.


Il nostro dovere è riportare la centralità della lotta palestinese al centro del movimento politico e popolare in Italia.


La causa palestinese non può essere liquidata come mera emergenza umanitaria, è una lotta politica per la liberazione.


Il 10 ottobre scendiamo in piazza in tutte le città italiane per la fine immediata del genocidio, lo sblocco degli aiuti e il ritiro dell’esercito di occupazione.


Saremo in piazza al fianco di tutti i popoli della regione che resistono all’imperialismo e alle aggressioni sioniste – in Yemen, Libano, Siria, Iraq e Iran – e contro le politiche di guerra che devastano i territori e le popolazioni.


Esprimiamo inoltre piena solidarietà a chi, anche in Italia, subisce la repressione per essersi mobilitato al fianco del popolo palestinese e contro il genocidio.


LE NOSTRE ISTANZE


Stop alla guerra e all’economia di guerra:


Blocco immediato del riarmo, contro l’aumento della spesa militare e l’invio, vendita e transito di armi da e verso l’entità sionista. Rescissione di ogni accordo di cooperazione militare, economica e accademica.


Stop alla criminalizzazione del dissenso:


Ritiro immediato del “DDL Antisemitismo” (che usa la definizione IHRA per equiparare l’antisionismo all’antisemitismo e silenziare la critica politica) e contro i cosiddetti Decreti


“Sicurezza” e tutte le misure repressive contro il movimento di solidarietà.


Libertà per i prigionieri politici in Italia:


Liberazione immediata per Anan Yaeesh, Ahmed Salem, Mohammed Hannoun, Ra’ed Dawoud, Yaser Elasaly, Riyad Albustanji e Abdelnuti Abunada.


Per il diritto del popolo palestinese alla resistenza, in tutte le sue forme, per l’ottenimento del proprio legittimo diritto all’autodeterminazione, alla liberazione e al ritorno, in tutta la Palestina, dal fiume al mare.


Contro la complicità diretta dello Stato italiano, terzo esportatore al mondo di armi verso “Israele” e corresponsabile nel genocidio del popolo palestinese: chiediamo l’immediata cessazione di ogni accordo militare, economico, diplomatico e accademico con l’entita sionista, l’imposizione di sanzioni severe e un embargo totale sulle armi.


Contro le politiche di riarmo europeo e italiano che pretendono di destinare fino al 5% del PIL alle spese militari e all’industria bellica, a scapito dei diritti sociali, sottraendo risorse fondamentali a sanita, istruzione, lavoro e welfare.


VERSO UNA MOBILITAZIONE POPOLARE E DEI LAVORATORI


Invitiamo le comunità, i sindacati, le organizzazioni politiche, i collettivi e le strutture studentesche e dei lavoratori a mobilitarsi per costruire un embargo popolare e pratiche concrete di boicottaggio economico, accademico e militare, intrecciando la lotta contro il genocidio e la guerra con quella contro lo sfruttamento e l’attacco continuo a diritti sociali.


10 OTTOBRE 2026


Da Roma a Milano, da Napoli a Torino, da Bologna a Palermo e in tutte le piazze italiane: Partecipate alle manifestazioni. Alziamo la bandiera della Palestina.

title: Sementes Livres & Rebeldes no 4 Festival de Sementes Crioulas da Bahia
content:
Entre camponeses, guardiões e guardiãs da agrobiodiversidade, pesquisadores e movimentos populares aconteceu a testagem de contaminação transgênica das sementes no 4º Festival de Sementes Crioulas da Bahia, realizado pelo MPA no Assentamento Terra Nossa, em Ponto Novo.


O projeto Laboratório Móvel da UFRB levou até os agricultores a tecnologia para verificar se suas sementes estavam contaminadas por transgênicos. Foram testados 3 tipos de milho produzidos no Assentamento Terra Vista por Mestre Valmir e militantes da rede: milho crioulo vermelho, milho de pipoca azul e milho guarani branco.


A metodologia foi explicada durante o festival: pesam-se 180 gramas de milho para cada 200 ml de água. Depois, a mistura é triturada no liquidificador, o líquido sobrenadante é separado e deixado descansar para ser pipetado. Em seguida, colocam-se 5 ml em cada um dos quatro microtubos e adicionam-se as fitas com anticorpos que reconhecem a proteína transgênica. Quando aparece apenas uma fitinha, o teste indica que o milho está livre de transgênicos. E foi exatamente isso que aconteceu: o milho de Seu Valmir, o grande guardião e mestre de variedades, deu negativo para transgenia.


As amostras se mostraram livres de qualquer contaminação. A universidade reafirmou seu compromisso com os movimentos populares, colocando-se de portas abertas para doar fitas e receber milhos para testagem a cada safra, todos os anos.


Esse resultado é especialmente significativo diante da dificuldade de cultivar milho sem contaminação. A polinização cruzada do milho pode alcançar um raio de mais de 50 km, o que torna a preservação das variedades crioulas um verdadeiro ato de resistência. A equipe reforçou que a contaminação das sementes não é culpa dos agricultores, mas sim do ataque direto do capital e do latifúndio sobre a autonomia e a soberania alimentar dos povos.


A rede agradece a todas e todos que apoiaram e apoiam essa caminhada, especialmente aqueles que contribuem no Apoia-se da rede. E faz um convite para que mais pessoas contribuam, para que aumente a salvaguarda das sementes crioulas e nativas. Afinal, quem tem terra, semeia. Quem não tem, apoia. Ninguém fica para trás.

apoia.se/teiadesementes

A ação foi possível graças ao projeto Laboratório Móvel da Universidade Federal do Recôncavo da Bahia (UFRB), que levou até os pequenos agricultores a tecnologia necessária para verificar se suas sementes haviam sido contaminadas por transgênicos do agronegócio. Foram testados quatro tipos de milho produzidos no Assentamento Terra Vista por Mestre Valmir e pelos militantes da rede: milho crioulo vermelho, milho de pipoca azul e milho guarani branco. O resultado foi emocionante: todas as amostras se mostraram livres de qualquer contaminação transgênica.

author: Software Architektur im Stream
title: Surviving the AI-Native Era with Sander Hoogendoorn
content:
In this episode Sander Hoogendoorn talks with Eberhard about his experience at iBOOD with AI-supported software development. Why abandon Pull Requests? What does AI-assisted coding review really change? And what happens to collaboration when AI is used?


We also look beyond the tools: How does AI change the role of developers, software architecture, and technical leadership? If developers increasingly own outcomes rather than keystrokes, what skills and practices become important?


And perhaps most importantly: What does it take not just to survive the AI-native era, but to thrive in it?


Sander will also talk about this subject at Software Architecture Gathering (2026-11-16 - 19, Berlin). Use code SATV_15 for 15% off.

title: No alla privatizzazione assicurata. Assicurazione sanitaria integrativa per il personale scolastico
content:
Sta facendo molto discutere l’introduzione nella scuola di una forma di assicurazione sanitaria integrativa che vede la ferma opposizione dei sindacati di base attivi nella scuola. Il 29 dicembre del 2025 è stato sottoscritto il contratto integrativo al cui interno si prevedeva, nel quadriennio 2025-29, un sistema di

assistenza sanitaria integrativa


per il

personale scolastico

. Una misura presentata, dal governo e dai sindacati che hanno sottoscritto tale accordo, come un “benefit”, una tutela in più, un segnale di attenzione verso chi lavora nella scuola. Una misura che in realtà contribuisce, come già avvenuto con il fondo Espero per quanto riguarda la previdenza integrativa, alla dismissione del sistema pubblico, sempre più tagliato, a tutto vantaggio di quello privato. Di seguito il comunicato nazionale di Unicobas Scuola


UNA POLIZZA TRAVESTITA DA WELFARE!


Dal 10 settembre gli oltre 1,2 milioni di dipendenti della scuola italiana possono aderire alla tanto annunciata assicurazione sanitaria integrativa gratuita. Il ministro Valditara e i sindacati che hanno aderito a tale progetto l’hanno presentata come un riconoscimento storico per chi lavora negli istituti d’istruzione di ogni ordine e grado, per la prima volta alla categoria viene garantita una tutela sanitaria collettiva.


È una narrazione avvincente, costruita apposta per dare un titolo di giornale o caricare uno spot sul web. Basta, però, leggere il capitolato tecnico e ascoltare chi nella scuola lavora, per scoprire che dietro l’annuncio si nasconde un provvedimento largamente insoddisfacente, costruito più per fare notizia che per rispondere a un bisogno reale.


Il paradosso dell’universalità selettiva


Il primo problema è già nella platea a cui si rivolge. Si rivendica l’assenza di distinzione, per la prima volta, tra personale di ruolo e supplenti, ma questa universalità si ferma proprio davanti a chi ne avrebbe più bisogno: i supplenti brevi restano fuori. È un’esclusione tutt’altro che marginale. Sono loro, ogni anno, a tenere in piedi la macchina scolastica riempiendo le cattedre vacanti fino all’ultimo giorno utile, ed è proprio questa fascia — la più esposta, la più povera di garanzie contrattuali — a essere lasciata fuori da una misura presentata come welfare universale. Difficile non leggerci una logica ricorrente nel sistema scuola italiano: i diritti si negano più facilmente a chi ha meno voce, e la precarietà si paga anche in salute, non solo in stipendio; si procede con diritti a geometria variabile, che spezzano l’unità della categoria dei lavoratori della scuola. Inoltre, la copertura è stata estesa anche ai dirigenti scolastici e ai dipendenti del Ministero. Sorge, di conseguenza, il ragionevole dubbio che se le risorse sono per legge vincolate a docenti e ATA, includere altri beneficiari significa una cosa sola: diluire la torta pro capite per chi lavora davvero in classe.


La polizza non sostituisce il SSN, lo “integra”, rispondendo appieno a quello che è il mantra neoliberista


Il secondo nodo riguarda la sostanza della copertura. Dietro la parola “gratuita” si nascondono franchigie stringenti, scoperti percentuali e tetti massimi di rimborso che lasceranno comunque una fetta consistente delle spese sulle spalle di chi dovrebbe beneficiarne. L’assicurazione non è una copertura indiscriminata di tutte le spese mediche, ma si concentra principalmente sui grandi interventi chirurgici, alta diagnostica (TAC, RMN), pacchetti prevenzione oncologica, cardiovascolare, odontoiatria base e parto e, sebbene la polizza copra anche patologie pregresse e croniche, rimangono a carico dell’assistito uno scoperto del 10% per le prestazioni in strutture convenzionate, con un limite massimo non indennizzabile di 4.000 euro per singolo evento. Inoltre, i ticket SSN non sono rimborsabili, i ricoveri lunghi per patologie croniche sono esclusi, c’è il vincolo della rete convenzionata, che per adesso non si sa quanto sarà ampia e come sarà distribuita sui territori (anche se per alcune prestazioni è ammesso il rimborso fuori rete). L’aiuto sulle spese ricorrenti come le visite specialistiche ordinarie, gli occhiali, la fisioterapia (quelle che pesano di più sui nuclei familiari), è molto limitato. Ancora più grave è l’esclusione dalla copertura assicurativa delle malattie mentali e dei disturbi psichici. Più dell’80% delle malattie professionali e delle cause di inidoneità all’insegnamento nei docenti italiani è di natura psichiatrica (ad es …

title: Ciao Bianca, ciao Dario.
content:
Ci uniamo al ricordo e al saluto del

Movimento No Tav

 per Bianca e per Dario che da poco ci hanno lasciati.


Di seguito le parole di Nicoletta per ricordare Bianca che ci ha lasciato in questi giorni. 


Cara Bianca……

Ti saluto con dolore, Bianca. La notizia della tua morte mi lascia un amaro vuoto dentro, l’ennesimo, quello della mia generazione che scompare, con le esperienze comuni, gli affetti ed i sogni condivisi.

Bianca e Alberto. Alberto, il magnifico aquilone che sapeva sfidare le altezze, Bianca, il filo che ne favoriva la salita, la mano che lo proteggeva controvento, tenendolo saldamente legato alla terra.

Certo questa metafora provocherebbe il sorriso della tua garbata ironia: tu eri l’antiretorica per eccellenza.. E non cercavi lodi o riconoscimenti: la tua grande generosità, l’amicizia sincera, la compassione concreta e silenziosa con cui ti prendevi cura di tutte le creature più deboli e indifese rifuggivano da palcoscenici ed elogi.

Ma certo non ti dimenticheranno le mie compagne di detenzione alle Vallette, le più povere e dimenticate con cui avevi avviato una corrispondenza e l’invio di aiuti economici. E mancherai certamente ai trecento gatti del carcere al cui mantenimento contribuivi nella tua vasta maternità..

Ci sentivamo periodicamente. Poche parole per telefono, per dirci la difficoltà a districarci fra le pastoie burocratiche dopo la morte dei nostri compagni e raccontarci il vuoto che l’amore per la lettura e la partecipazione al movimento NO TAV non bastavano a colmare.

Il tuo impegno sociale, civile, culturale è stato di tutta la vita, dalla parte delle donne, delle lotte operaie, nel Movimento valsusino di lotta nonviolenta, nella redazione di Dialogo in Valle, il foglio periodico del gruppo. La biblioteca comunale di Condove ti ha avuta per anni come bibliotecaria volontaria e competente.

Ma certamente i momenti più belli e preziosi sono legati al movimento NO TAV, una storia che abbiamo condiviso fin dall’inizio e che ancora dura e certo continuerà anche dopo di noi, cara Bianca, perchè non è solo la lotta contro un treno, ma contro il sistema che lo produce, disumano ed ecocida. In questa lotta continueremo ad esserci anche noi, tutte e tutti, perchè l’amore non muore.

Ciao, Bianca.

Un abbraccio alla tua famiglia ed a tutta la grande famiglia NO TAV.


Dario ci ha lasciato…

Sempre presente ad ogni iniziativa di lotta e di festa, sino a quando il suo “cuore ballerino “glielo ha permesso è stato al nostro fianco.. sempre.


Manchi e mancherai caro Dario, mancherà il tuo sorriso, mancheranno le tue battute, mancherà la tua presenza… A noi resterà il tuo ricordo e continueremo a portarti con noi in ogni momento.


Ciao Dario saluta tutti i compagni che incontrerai lassù.

Sempre NO TAV

author: Soraya Kishtwari
title: Spain Moves Ahead With US Extradition Case Against Pro-Palestine Millionaire
content:
The Spanish government has allowed an extradition request from the Trump administration to proceed to court, in the first known case of the US seeking to extradite a citizen over alleged support for Hamas.


Defence lawyers for James ‘Fergie’ Chambers, a wealthy donor to leftwing and pro-Palestine causes, say their client is being targeted for his political views. 


Under Spanish law, an extradition request cannot proceed if it is found to be politically motivated.


While the US has yet to publicly outline the full charges against Chambers, his legal team say he is accused of laundering $7.5m (£5.6m) in Tunisia to support Hamas – a charge they strongly deny. 


Chambers’ wife Stella Schnabel, who is Jewish, said the US has failed to provide any evidence for its allegations.


Spain’s national court will now examine the request, with a hearing expected in the coming weeks before the government makes its final decision. Chambers has applied for asylum in Spain, according to his lawyer.


Chambers, a multimillionaire media heir and self-described communist who previously donated to Occupy Wall Street and the Stop Cop City movement, has been held in pre-trial detention in Madrid since his arrest in Ibiza on 10 July.


The decision to allow the case to proceed to the national court is likely to anger members of Spain’s

leftwing governing coalition

, after they previously urged prime minister Pedro Sánchez not to advance the request.


The move – seen as a test case for Sánchez – comes amid strained relations with the Trump administration over Spain’s support for Palestine.


Around 150 public figures, including activist Greta Thunberg, actor Richard Gere and writer Fatima Bhutto, have signed a letter urging Spain not to proceed with the extradition. 


“This extradition would set an alarming precedent in ​Europe if ⁠Spain permits the Trump administration to criminalise humanitarian aid vital to the Palestinian people,”

said Chambers’ lawyer Baltasar Garzon

.


Chambers has donated more than $1m to humanitarian causes in Gaza and paid legal fees for some members of Palestine Action, his lawyers say.

author: Unknown
title: Imperia: incontro pubblico contro il riarmo
content:
Riceviamo e volentieri pubblichiamo questo contributo che racconta il percorso contro il riarmo che si sta sviluppando a Imperia, territorio già nell’occhio del ciclone per quanto riguarda i progetti di eolico industriale previsti sui monti liguri di cui avevamo parlato in questi articoli:

Continua la mobilitazione contro il progetto di parco eolico Imperia Monti Moro e Guardiabella

,

Passeggiata resistente a Guardiabella: Una giornata di gioiosa lotta!

 e

Territori provinciali al centro della bufera da impianti eolici: da Imperia alle montagne al confine tra Piemonte, Lombardia e Liguria ci si organizza per difendere la propria terra

.


Il 12 settembre a Imperia la assemblea pubblica

La scuola (non va) alla guerra

 organizzata dal Comitato No riarmo ha visto la presenza di circa 80 cittadine/i, docenti e studenti confluiti in un’ampia sala del monastero delle Clarisse di Porto Maurizio.


Dopo una bella introduzione a cura del Comitato, il fenomeno della militarizzazione è stato illustrato nei suoi diversi aspetti da Maria Teresa Silvestrini (Osservatorio contro la militarizzazione delle scuole e delle università) e da Michelangelo Benza (USB Scuola Imperia). Molta impressione hanno suscitato nel pubblico le immagini della militarizzazione delle scuole e della società tratte dalla Fotogallery dell’Osservatorio https:// osservatorionomilscuola.com/galleria-scuole-militarizzate/ (a cura del Comitato stesso).


Le immagini mostrano infatti molto bene l’intento di

normalizzazione della guerra

 attraverso

l’abitudine e la assuefazione alla presenza della divisa e delle armi,

 che coinvolge sia i più piccoli sia studenti delle superiori con le loro famiglie, attraverso molteplici eventi, iniziative, commemorazioni, organizzati anche come momenti ludici e di festa (Villaggi dell’esercito, Magic Land, visite a caserme, ecc.). E’ stato fatto notare che la tecnica psicologica usata è molto elementare e nota: si tratta di un condizionamento di tipo comportamentista, teoria elaborata all’inizio del Novecento dallo psicologo statunitense John Watson, basato sulla ripetuta associazione di stimoli, molto usata nella pubblicità e dai social. Infatti, più si è esposti a uno stimolo in associazione con un altro stimolo, più si interiorizzerà emotivamente la associazione stessa. Dunque, più la divisa, la pistola, il fucile, il carroarmato, sono proposti e vissuti come momenti e strumenti di gioco e divertimento, più le emozioni nei loro confronti saranno amichevoli e positive.


Altrettanta impressione ha suscitato il fatto che la propaganda per costruire consenso alla guerra ibrida ormai dichiarata sia costruita attraverso un articolato Programma di comunicazione della Difesa, con una vera e propria strategia di marketing. Nel 2025, ad esempio, il Programma prevedeva la “acquisizione di una semantica” condivisa intorno alla parola “Difesa” (https://www.difesa.it/assets/allegati/3706/pc_md_2025.pdf), mentre nel 2026 la comunicazione della Difesa è stata presentata come “architettura cognitiva di resilienza nazionale. Un

dome

 informativo che accompagna il Paese nella comprensione della minaccia e nella fiducia per la propria protezione”. https://www.esercito.difesa.it/assets/allegati/pc_md_2026.2026.02.03.14.02.04.237.pdf


Particolare apprezzamento è stato mostrato dal pubblico quando è stato detto che queste forme di militarizzazione possono essere interpretate come processi di

israelizzazione

, in quanto ogni cittadina e cittadino dovrebbero essere coinvolti e supportivi nei confronti delle Forze Armate e della difesa.


Si è poi trattato di aspetti specifici relativi alla scuola come il

reclutamento,

 attraverso l’orientamento e la Formazione Scuola Lavoro presso aziende belliche e basi militari, e il

disciplinamento

, attraverso l’ampliamento dell’offerta formativa in tema di bullismo, cyberbullismo, educazione alla legalità, violenza contro le donne, persino educazione alimentare, trattati in chiave punitiva quando invece, come abbiamo insistentemente ripetuto, su tali fenomeni dovrebbero intervenire esperte/i, educatrici ed educatori, psicologi.


L’ultimo aspetto importante e recente è la

presenza di aziende belliche

 nelle scuole, come nel caso di Leonardo, che a Roma interviene in almeno 19 istituti oltre a governare direttamente il liceo Matteucci (https://osservatorionomilscuola.com/2026/08/13/dossier-bds-scuole-industria-militare-forme-dispositivi-complicita-genocidio-roma/).


E’ stato anche …

author: newsroom
title: «Ούλοι εμείς εφέντη»: Κάλεσμα των Προσφυγικών σε πορεία «Επανασύνδεσης και Συνέχειας»
content:
Σύνδεσμος δημοσίευσης:

«Ούλοι εμείς εφέντη»: Κάλεσμα των Προσφυγικών σε πορεία «Επανασύνδεσης και Συνέχειας»


“ΟΥΛΟΙ ΕΜΕΙΣ ΕΦΕΝΤΗ”


26/9 ΠΟΡΕΙΑ ΕΠΑΝΑΣΥΝΔΕΣΗΣ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΝΕΧΕΙΑΣ


Σύμφωνα με την προφορική παράδοση, οι Ικαριώτες, αγανακτισμένοι από τον εξαναγκασμό και την τυραννία, έριξαν σε έναν γκρεμό έναν Οθωμανό αξιωματούχο, που ανάγκαζε τους κατοίκους να τον κουβαλούν στα χέρια πάνω σε φορείο. Όταν οι αρχές τους συγκέντρωσαν για να μάθουν ποιοι έκαναν το φόνο, κανείς δεν πρόδωσε. Απάντησαν με περηφάνια «ούλοι εμείς, εφέντη», αναλαμβάνοντας από κοινού την συλλογική ευθύνη.


ΚΑΛΕΣΜΑ ΣΕ ΚΕΝΤΡΙΚΗ ΠΟΡΕΙΑ 26/9 ΠΟΛΥΤΕΧΝΕΙΟ ΣΤΙΣ 18:00


ΓΙΑ ΤΟΝ ΑΓΩΝΑ ΠΟΥ ΔΟΘΗΚΕ ΚΑΙ ΚΕΡΔΗΘΗΚΕ ΣΥΛΛΟΓΙΚΑ – ΓΙΑ ΤΟΥΣ ΑΓΩΝΕΣ ΠΟΥ ΘΑ ΔΟΘΟΥΝ ΚΑΙ ΘΑ ΚΕΡΔΗΘΟΥΝ ΣΥΛΛΟΓΙΚΑ


[…] Κι έτσι ο καθένας προχωράει βάζοντας το μερίδιο αίματος που του αντιστοιχεί μέχρι να εξεγερθούν κι άλλοι, μέχρι την εποχή που όλοι όρθιοι θα βάλουμε έναν νέο ήλιο σ’ ένα νέο ουρανό[…]


Subcomandante Marcos


Υπάρχουν στιγμές που ένας συλλογικός αγώνας αφήνει τέτοιο υλικό και ηθικό αποτύπωμα ώστε είναι αδύνατον να προσπεραστεί. Είναι εκείνες οι στιγμές που η κοινωνία παίρνει ξανά τη δύναμή της στα χέρια της, υψώνονται τα βλέμματα και έχει ήδη παρθεί η απόφαση της νίκης. Κι έτσι ανοίγονται ρωγμές. Ρωγμές – παράθυρα σε έναν διαφορετικό κόσμο, από τις οποίες ξεπηδάει η ζωή.


Αυτές τις στιγμές μοιραστήκαμε τους τελευταίους μήνες, ως Κοινότητα Κατειλημμένων Προσφυγικών, με όλους τους συντρόφους και γείτονές μας, με τους συντρόφους μας απεργούς πείνας μέχρι θανάτου Αριστοτέλη Χαντζή και Suzon Doppagne και από κοινού με όλους τους ανθρώπους της αλληλεγγύης που βαδίσαμε κι αγωνιστήκαμε πλάι πλάι. Αυτόν τον πολύ όμορφο αγώνα μοιραστήκαμε, που η παρακαταθήκη του στο παρόν και το μέλλον απλώνεται μπροστά μας τώρα φωτίζοντας μια τεράστια δυνατότητα.


Η νίκη αυτή είναι μια υπόθεση συλλογική. Αποτελεί μια ακόμη απόδειξη πως όταν περάσουμε από το εγώ στο εμείς μπορούμε να ανασυγκροτήσουμε την πολυδιασπασμένη μας ισχύ ως κοινωνίες και κινήματα από τα κάτω. Μπορούμε να ξαναχτίσουμε το συλλογικό φαντασιακό του κόσμου της αλληλεγγύης, της καθημερινής αντίστασης απέναντι στην εξαθλίωση, τον φόβο, την υποταγή, την εξατομίκευση.


Αυτούς τους μήνες, άνθρωποι και αγώνες συναντήθηκαν. Μέσα από τις αντιθέσεις και τη διαφορετικότητα, ένα ευρύ κοινωνικό μέτωπο δημιουργήθηκε και στο διάβα του συμπαρέσυρε πολλές από τις βεβαιότητες του κόσμου της εξουσίας: Το ότι η καταστολή και η ήττα είναι δεδομένες. Το ότι οι αγώνες δίνονται μονοθεματικά και μέσα σε στενά όρια και μερικές φορές για την τιμή των όπλων. Το ότι ο κατακερματισμός είναι αναγκαίος. Το ότι η εξατομικευμένη νεοφιλελεύθερη αντίληψη του εαυτού και του κόσμου είναι παντοδύναμη και τα θεμέλια της ανθρώπινης συνεργασίας, της αλληλεγγύης και της αυτοθέσμισης των κοινωνιών έχουν αποσαθρωθεί.


Δε χρειάστηκε να ειπωθούν πολλά όλον αυτόν τον καιρό – και ταυτόχρονα έχουν ειπωθεί σχεδόν όλα μέσα στον αγώνα. Και η ουσία όλων αυτών είναι πως είδαμε να υφαίνεται ξανά το συλλογικό φαντασιακό μέσα από την αναγνώριση της ανάγκης να ξαναβρούμε τους δεσμούς αλληλεγγύης και κοινότητας μεταξύ μας, ως τον πυρήνα των συλλογικών αντιστάσεων.


Γιατί στις κοινότητες συναντιούνται οι άνθρωποι, εκεί συλλογικοποιούνται οι ανάγκες και οργανώνονται οι απαντήσεις. Κι από την ανάγκη στην οργάνωση κι από την οργάνωση στον αγώνα και τη διεκδίκηση, ανοίγουν διάπλατα μπροστά μας μονοπάτια για να τα βαδίσουμε συλλογικά.


Και είναι οι κοινότητες που δεν αποτελούν μόνο τον τόπο αλλά και τον τρόπο αυτοεκπαίδευσης, συμμετοχής, δέσμευσης, υπέρβασης. Και τελικά εκεί επιστρέφει όλη η δύναμη, η γνώση, η δυνατότητα, αλλά και το κόστος, που γεννούν νέα δύναμη, νέα γνώση και νέα δυνατότητα και κόστος σε κάθε επόμενο κύκλο.


Ερχόμενοι και ερχόμενες στο σήμερα, και έχοντας κλείσει τον πρώτο μεγάλο αυτό κύκλο πλέον και με τον σύντροφό μας Αρίστο κοντά μας, αυτό που βλέπουμε καθαρά πως έχουμε να υπερασπιστούμε δεν είναι μόνο αυτή η συγκεκριμένη νίκη. Ήταν εξάλλου μια μόνο νίκη σε έναν αδιάκοπο πόλεμο που συνεχίζεται από τα κράτη, τον καπιταλισμό και τον κόσμο της εξουσίας ενάντια στις κοινωνίες, τα κινήματα, τη φύση και τους ανθρώπους. Έχουμε, όμως, να υπερασπιστούμε τη δυνατότητα που αυτή η νίκη άνοιξε: τη δυνατότητα οι αγώνες να συναντιούνται, να αναγνωρίζουν και να συμπληρώνουν ο ένας τον άλλον και τη δυνατότητα οι κοινωνίες να αυτοθεσμίζονται πάνω στις ανάγκες και το συλλογικό τους φαντασιακό και να συγκροτούν κοινότητες αντίστασης, οπουδήποτε οι άνθρωποι αγωνίζονται: στις γειτονιές, σε …

author: Mag
title: Der Widerstand gegen die Folgen der Profitkrise für die Auto-Belegschaften wächst
content:
Dossier


„

Die Personalkosten sind nicht der Grund für die Probleme von VW, Daimler oder BMW, auch nicht von Conti, Bosch oder ZF. (IG Metall Verhandlungsführer Thorsten Gröger, 28.10.2024, ZDF) Deshalb gibt es keinen Grund, die Löhne in der Auto- und Zulieferindustrie zu senken. Die IG Metall hat aber allen Grund, die Einkommen und sozialen Rechte der Arbeiter:innen zu verteidigen! In den ersten drei Quartalen 2024 haben die großen drei VW, Mercedes und BMW Profite in Höhe von etwa 20 Milliarden Euro erzielt. Die Krise wird herbeigeredet, um Ängste zu schüren und Sozialabbau durchzusetzen. Unbegreiflich, dass die IG Metall dennoch erklärt: »Wir sind bereit, einen Beitrag zu leisten.«.

..“ Aus dem Leitartikel „Wem gehören die Fabriken? Euch gehören die Fabriken!“ der

„Aktionszeitung – für eine Verkehrsindustrie mit Zukunft“

 Nr. 1 vom März 2025, mit der auch die IG Metall zum Widerstand statt Sozialpartnerschaft aufgerufen wird – siehe weitere herstellerübergreifende Aufrufe aus der Autoindustrie:


Unter dem Motto „Zukunft statt Kahlschlag“ protestierten am 21. September rund 175.000 Arbeiter*innen der Autoindustrie an 280 Orten – nicht alle für gleiche Ziele


[IG Metall] Automobil-Aktionstag: Beschäftigte demonstrieren für Zukunft statt Kahlschlag


„

Rund 175.000 Beschäftigte protestieren gegen Stellenabbau und Werksschließungen in der Autoindustrie. „Die Beschäftigten sind nicht länger bereit, für eine Krise zu zahlen, die sie nicht verschuldet haben“, sagt Christiane Benner, Erste Vorsitzende der IG Metall. Nötig sind Zukunftsinvestitionen.  (…)


Unter dem Motto „Zukunft statt Kahlschlag“ haben heute rund 175.000 Beschäftigte gegen Angriffe der Arbeitgeber auf ihre Arbeitsplätze und Arbeitsbedingungen in der Automobilindustrie demonstriert. Sie trafen sich bei rund 280 Aktionen im gesamten Bundesgebiet – auf besonderen, eigens für diesen Tag anberaumten Betriebsversammlungen, bei protestartigen, aktiven Mittagspausen, bei Kundgebungen vor den Werkstoren, bei Demonstrationen auf öffentlichen Plätzen und bei ähnlichen Veranstaltungen. Laut und unmissverständlich machten sie sich für die Zukunft der Autoindustrie in Deutschland stark. Beteiligt waren Beschäftigte aller großen Autohersteller sowie Dutzender großer und kleinerer Zulieferer. Die Beschäftigten kritisierten Angriffe auf ihre Rechte, jahrelanges Missmanagement sowie falsche Krisenkonzepte der Unternehmen. Lautstark forderten sie die Arbeitgeber auf: „Stoppt den Kahlschlag und investiert endlich in die Zukunft unserer Werke!“ (…)


Die IG Metall drängt darum darauf, die Branche in Deutschland wieder zukunftsfest aufzustellen, indem Unternehmen auf Innovation setzen, in Zukunftsfelder investieren und ihre Strategie an die veränderten Märkte anpassen. Die heftigen Angriffe der Arbeitgeberseite auf Rechte der Beschäftigten wie die 35-Stunden-Woche, Tarifverträge und Mitbestimmung verurteilt die IG Metall als in der Sache falsch, nicht zielführend und ungerecht.


Die IG Metall fordert zudem eine aktive Industriepolitik ein, die die veränderten globalen Rahmenbedingungen ernstnimmt und gegensteuert: Mit gezielter Förderung, wirksamem Handelsschutz und klaren Local-Content-Vorgaben. author: EDRi
title: EDRi-gram, 23 September 2026
content:
What has the EDRi network been up to over the past few weeks? Find out the latest digital rights news in our bi-weekly newsletter. In this edition: Turning up the heat – Commission backs social media bans, Apple held accountable, summer to-dos, & more!

What a historic summer we’ve been through. From multiple sweltering heatwaves that killed thousands of people, unprecedented wildfires, and rivers and waterways drying up, 2026 was the hottest summer on record for many countries across Europe and beyond.

It was also historic for other upsetting reasons – even as we suffered through heatwaves, with money for social services and climate resilience drying up, the EU launched a call for AI gigafactories, essentially investing billions of euros of public funds into climate-busting data centres. Age verification and social media bans for young people gained further traction, with France passing a bill to ban social media for people under 15, and other EU countries discussing similar proposals.

It all came to a head last week. European Commission President von der Leyen’s State of the Union (SOTEU) address officially ended the summer mood in Brussels, and launched us into what’s setting up to be an extremely busy, and critical, period ahead for protecting digital justice.

A key part of that struggle with be the KIDS Act, announced during the SOTEU, which will restrict social media access across the EU for people under 13 and also also exclude anyone who cannot verify their age – such as people who don’t have access to the right documentation due to being unhoused or their migration status. Instead of raising the bar and making the internet safer for all, the EU’s approach seems to be one of exclusion and putting up walls.

We’ve long maintained that safer online spaces for everyone – including young people – will require addressing the issue that’s at the root of it all: the business model and extractive practices of online platforms. Thankfully, important work is being done on that front by EDRi member D3 who have brought the first class-action lawsuits of their kind in the EU against Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube over the “addictive design” of these platforms.

Other things we’re paying close attention to: the spyware scandals in Serbia, this time targeting members of the student movement and opposition political parties right before the election. The Digital Omnibus saga also continues. EU governments could be just days away from agreeing to a disastrous deal on the Digital Omnibus on Data that would weaken some of the basic protections people rely on under the GDPR, such as knowing who is using their data, objecting to certain uses or expecting their data to be kept secure.

Europe’s cookie law is really a law about surveillance The ePrivacy framework limits commercial tracking and state access to communications. It is now being weakened from several directions at once. Read more

author: Redazione_web
title: Il canto anarchico in Italia. Terza edizione – ormai un classico!
content:
S. Catanuto e F. Schirone


Il canto anarchico in Italia nell’Ottocento e nel Novecento


Terza edizione


Ed. Zero in Condotta, Milano


pagg. 416, euro 20,00


Per richieste:

zic@zeroincondotta.org


La terza edizione di questo libro è stata pubblicata da Zero in Condotta a fronte di numerose richieste. Per chi già conosce l’opera e soprattutto per chi viene a conoscerla ora, si tratta di una pubblicazione di canti che copre un periodo che va dalla Comune di Parigi (1871) e arriva a tempi a noi più recenti, attraversando eventi e avvenimenti che hanno fatto la storia d’Italia dal punto di vista di un popolo vessato, ribelle, proletario, antistatalista ma federalista, che anela ad una società basata sulla solidarietà e l’uguaglianza tra gli individui, all’abbattimento dello sfruttamento dell’uomo sull’uomo, all’amore verso gli ultimi, alla socializzazione dei mezzi di produzione, ad una organizzazione sociale senza governo o Stato, senza servi e senza padroni…


Canti che, già soli, narrano le vicende dell’anarchismo. Canti che spronano gli sfruttati all’organizzazione, a difendersi e attaccare la prepotenza dei padroni e dell’organizzazione statale, a combattere contro le guerre e per la diserzione, a opporsi a tutte le dittature, a costruire isole di antistato e a fare controinformazione sulle repressioni che periodicamente si sono abbattute sul movimento anarchico: sempre risorto dalle ceneri sotto le quali i potenti e i prepotenti di turno hanno tentato di seppellirlo!


Le canzoni anarchiche hanno sempre affascinato e continuano ad affascinare, basti leggere i canti di Pietro Gori, antesignano di tutto. Non a caso sono riprese ancora oggi da innumerevoli cori, da cultori del canto sociale, da studenti per le loro tesi di laurea, da singol*, fuori e dentro il movimento specifico, da gruppi musicali, come Les Anarchistes o i Montelupo – solo per citarne alcuni -, da gruppi spontanei e singoli musicisti (Alessio Lega…): il loro repertorio ha attinto molto da questo lavoro editoriale incrementandolo con nuovi canti, rendendolo sempre più vivo.


Oggi questa mappatura, che può essere fruita da più prospettive (storica, musicale, sociale…) vede la luce con una terza edizione che evidenzia chiaramente un vero successo editoriale delle nostre edizioni.


Santo Catanuto e Franco Schirone
